ops.title: 12.68.0 on a 100 MB transcript: undeclared hooks still skip, now on the deadline
ops.body:
Probe 2026-10-01 ~09:10Z, capt-hookd 12.68.0 + cc-transcript 14.30.0 installed (package-install). PreToolUse Bash 'gh pr view 223 --json state,mergedAt,mergeStateStatus,mergeable' through plugin bin/hook:
- 20-line transcript: graphite landing_state_through_ccx fires (warn text present).
- 83 MB static copy and the live 100 MB root transcript 900424b6: landing_state_through_ccx and pr_landing_fields:nudge_ad665f79 skip on 'foreground transcript deadline exhausted' / 'snapshot transport deadline elapsed', every run (0.3-0.9 s). Repeated runs stay silent by design; the warm path never makes the full acquire fit 0.75 s.
Cause: those hooks declare no transcript_events window (landing_state_through_ccx needs one for skip_if RanCommand), so dispatch does a full-file acquire. Byte budget removal only changed the skip reason.
Fix options: (a) capt-hook sends a tail window on every hook acquire once cc-transcript 14.31.0 (tail_bytes windowed acquire, task #112) ships; (b) declare transcript_events on builtin hooks now.
Also: fail_open.py logs only the first skip per hook, but the context line says 'capt-hook logs --session <id> lists every skip' - false; fix in the follow-up.
